info.title: Mangrove Server API
info.description:
Submit and retrieve reviews,
as well as aggregate statistics about reviews.

## Documentation & Resources

- 📚 [Open Reviews Standard](https://mangrove.reviews/standard) - Complete specification and protocol details
- 📖 [Schema Guide](https://mangrove.reviews/schema-guide) - Detailed schema documentation
- 🔍 [JWT Inspector](https://inspect.mangrove.reviews/) - Interactive tool to construct, inspect, and validate review JWTs
- 🌐 [Mangrove Reference App](https://mangrove.reviews) - Read and write reviews in the browser
- 🐘 [Fediverse bridge](https://social.mangrove.reviews) - Follow reviewers and subjects from Mastodon
- 📦 [Mangrove Client JS Library](https://js.mangrove.reviews/) - JavaScript wrapper for this API

post.summary: Triggers a dump of all reviews to S3 in all supported formats
post.description:
This endpoint dumps all reviews from the database to S3 in three formats:
- JSON (with reviews, issuers, and maresi_subjects)
- CSV
- N-Triples RDF

Returns a list of results with S3 keys and presigned download URLs valid for 7 days.

Requires `X-API-Key` header with valid API key.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing API key

get.summary: Gets the latest dump and redirects to the download URL
get.description:
This endpoint redirects to the presigned download URL for the most recent
database dump in the requested format. The format is determined by the
`Accept` header:
- `application/json` (default): Latest JSON dump
- `text/csv` or `text/html`: Latest CSV dump
- `application/n-triples`: Latest N-Triples dump

Note: This endpoint returns a 302 redirect. Use `curl -L` to follow the redirect.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Dump format to retrieve: application/json (default), text/csv, text/html, application/n-triples

302.description: Redirect to the latest dump download URL

404.description: No dump files found for the requested format

get.summary: Request reviews matching the provided query.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search for reviews that have this string in `sub` or `opinion` field.

parameters.name: signature
parameters.description: Review with this `signature` value.

parameters.name: kid
parameters.description: Reviews by issuer with the following PEM public key.

parameters.name: did
parameters.description: Reviews by every key bound to the identity with this DID.

parameters.name: alias
parameters.description: Reviews by every key bound to the identity that verified this alias, given without its scheme.

parameters.name: iat
parameters.description: Reviews issued at this UNIX time.

parameters.name: gt_iat
parameters.description: Reviews with UNIX timestamp greater than this.

parameters.name: sub
parameters.description: Reviews of the given subject URI. For a `geo:` URI, reviews whose location lies within the `u` radius around the given coordinates, extended by each review's own `u` value, and whose `q` name equals the given one without case, punctuation and accents. A review or a query without a name matches on location alone. Subjects joined by an accepted equivalence claim are included.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Reviews with the given rating.

parameters.name: opinion
parameters.description: Reviews with the given opinion.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of reviews to return. Default is based on format. Requests exceeding format-specific recommended limits will be rejected: JSON/N-Triples max 3500, CSV/HTML max 7000.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of reviews to skip before returning results. Used for pagination. Must be non-negative.

parameters.name: opinionated
parameters.description: Only reviews which either contain or do not contain an opinion.

parameters.name: examples
parameters.description: Include reviews left for example subjects `https://example.com` and `geo:0,0?q=*u=*`.

parameters.name: issuers
parameters.description: Include aggregate information about review issuers.

parameters.name: maresi_subjects
parameters.description: Include aggregate information about reviews of returned reviews.

parameters.name: latest_edits_only
parameters.description: For edited reviews, return only the most recent version (true by default)

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Filter by action type (e.g., `equivalence`, `edit`). Use `*` to include all actions. By default, equivalence claims are excluded.

413.description: Response payload too large. Reduce limit parameter or add more filters.

put.summary: Submit a new review or perform actions on existing reviews
put.description:
Submit a Mangrove Review as a JWT. The system automatically detects the operation type based on the payload structure.

## Resources

- 📚 [Open Reviews Standard](https://mangrove.reviews/standard) - Complete specification
- 📖 [Schema Guide](https://mangrove.reviews/schema-guide) - Detailed schema documentation
- 🔍 [JWT Inspector](https://inspect.mangrove.reviews/) - Tool to construct, inspect, and validate JWTs

## Request Format

Standard JWT format: `header.payload.signature`

**Header** must include:
- `alg`: "ES256" (ECDSA P-256)
- `typ`: "JWT"
- `kid`: Public key in PEM format

**Payload** can be one of 6 types (see [Payload schema](#/components/schemas/Payload) in the API documentation):
- **Review**: Review any subject (requires `sub` (non-maresi), `rating`)
- **Rating**: Rate a review (requires `sub` (maresi), `rating`)
- **Comment**: Comment on a review (requires `sub` (maresi), `opinion`)
- **Edit**: Edit your review (requires `sub` (maresi), `action: "edit"`, same key)
- **Delete**: Delete your review (requires `sub` (maresi), `action: "delete"`, same key)
- **ReportAbuse**: Report abuse (requires `sub` (maresi), `action: "report_abuse"`)
- **Equivalence**: Assert equivalence between subjects or keys (requires `sub`, `action: "equivalence"`, `opinion` containing target URI or key PEM)

**Signature**: ECDSA P-256 signature using the private key corresponding to the public key in header.

## Key Concepts

- **Maresi URIs** (`urn:maresi:{signature}`): Reference existing reviews for interactions and actions
- **Subject URIs**: Regular URIs (https://, geo:, isbn:, lei:) for reviewing actual subjects
- **Timestamps**: All `iat` fields must be Unix timestamp ≥ 2020-01-01 (Mangrove epoch)
- **Authentication**: Edit and delete operations require the same public key as the original review

parameters.name: jwt_review
parameters.description: JWT string in format `header.payload.signature`. When decoded, the JWT contains: `kid` (public key in header), `payload` ([Payload schema](#/components/schemas/Payload) with review data), and `signature` (ECDSA signature). Use the [JWT Inspector](https://inspect.mangrove.reviews/) to construct and validate JWTs. For test reviews, use `https://example.com`, `geo:0,0?q=Test&u=100`, `urn:isbn:9780000000002`, or `urn:lei:00000000000000000098` in the `sub` field. These test URIs skip external resource validation.

data_source.description: Please provide the source of the review if the review does not originate from the author.

experience_context.description: Should be one of common contexts in which the reviewer primarily had experience with the subject: `business`, `family`, `couple`, `friends`, `solo`.

original_url.description: URL of the original review on the source platform, used for deduplication when importing from external sources.

reviewer_index.description: Unique index used by the reviewer, usually indicating a ranking in a list. Must be a valid JavaScript safe integer.
